label: sdc01_0000_ecology_02
text: Sorry to bother you while you’re probably out\nsearching for some nice treasure...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0000_ecology_03
text:
You see, we have a school trip every year around
this time.\c
It’s a special collaboration between our academy
and another school.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0000_ecology_06
text: You’ll get to go study and experience the great\noutdoors off to the east—in the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]land of Kitakami[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0000_ecology_07
text:
It’s a long trip to get to this year’s destination,
so we can’t send too many students this time.\c
You really are a lucky one, getting selected as
one of the participants![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0000_ecology_08
text: Come to the school’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]entrance hall[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] when you’re\nready to hear all the details.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0000_ecology_09
text: Of course, you don’t HAVE to take part. But this\nkind of chance isn’t likely to come again, so you\r\nshould really give it a shot if you’re interested![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
